title: Executable tool audit exposes source mutation and diagnostic integrity defects
wanted_capability: Every advertised local binding needs an executable success or explicit refusal contract, applied source validation and truthful diagnostics.
missing_primitive: Practical coverage for all local tools, including Java/Rust proposal compilation, LSP Unicode positions, analysis ownership, fetched source fidelity and compiler JSON ingestion.
fallback_used: Use exact source primitives, compile applied proposals, and retire transforms without coherent supported behavior.
notes: Current beta fixes and runtime receipts are in progress. This tracks uncovered contracts, not model efficiency.
resolution_note: Completed executable coverage of all 104 original local tools plus five conditional harness tools. Retired broken Java column extraction; fixed source/diagnostic fidelity, Java/Rust transforms, analysis ownership, LSP coordinate handling, cancellation and shared output budgets. Runtime source 382240164574 passed 1792 focused tests and 6972 full cluster tests, Clippy and concurrency checks, and was installed and deployed with successful health verification. Exact dispositions and reproduction runners are in design/bro-harness/model-facing-audit/runtime-coverage.json and linked family reports. These are correctness contracts, not model-efficiency claims.
